english.title: Infanticide
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused the death of your child under the age of twelve months by a wilful

(A)_[act,]_
(B)_[omission,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY ACT OR OMISSION..), at a time when the balance of your mind was disturbed by reason of your not having fully recovered from the effect of giving birth to the child or by reason of the effect of lactation consequent upon the birth of the child
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Infanticide Act 1938.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused the death of own child under age 12 months
by wilful act/omission
balance of mind disturbed by you not having recovered from giving birth to the child/effect of lactation consequent upon birth of the child

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The child must be under the age of 12 months.
(ii) The date of offence will be the date death occurs.
(iii) This offence is only appropriate to reduce what would otherwise be an act of murder to a lesser offence where the killing is done by a mother at a time when responsibility for her actions may have been reduced by the disturbance of her mind caused by the stress of the child's birth - post natal depression.
(iv) See section 2(2) of the Infant Life (Preservation) Act 1929 for the alternative verdict of child destruction.

other.penalty:
Life imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
